summary: `sync`'s per-item typed-table dispatch must remap the sync resource name `"ledger-balances"` to the typed table name `"balance"` -- the two names differ, and the generated dispatch matches on literal resource name, so without the remap every synced balance row silently lands only in the generic `resources` table and never populates local financial reports.
reason: Discovered live: all 58 real balance rows from a full sync landed only under resource_type="ledger-balances" in the generic table, silently skipping the typed `balance` table every local report reads from. Mock-mode verification never exercises the real sync-resource-name-to-table-name mismatch because it doesn't drive a full multi-resource sync.
validated_outcome: Live full sync populates the typed `balance` table (58 rows matched the API count); local financial reports that read from it stopped returning empty.
